title: ENG-9148: feat(compiler): incremental compile cache & warm hot-reload daemon (REFLEX_COMPILE_CACHE)
author: FarhanAliRaza

unresolved.first_comment: P2 Watch all recorded in-project data dependencies: editing a .json/.yaml/.toml/.txt/.csv data file a page reads does not wake the compile daemon; watched suffix list only includes .py, .md, .mdx (reflex/utils/compile_daemon.py:38)

P2 Hash include-path modules before reusing pages: with REFLEX_HOT_RELOAD_INCLUDE_PATHS the dependency graph keeps only modules under Path.cwd(), so sibling-package edits reuse stale .web output (page_cache.py:595)
P2 Hash transitive deps of warm dynamic imports: only the module returned by a runtime import is recorded; its own imports are not added to the page dependency set (page_cache.py:261)

P1 Preloaded app untracked: when config.app_module is already populated, record_app_import() captures no reads, so dynamically loaded theme/app wrap edits can leave stale app-root output (prerequisites.py:208, 2026-07-14)

the practical problem with resetting this every time is that the generated names are order-dependent... i think we need a little more machinery here; _UNIQUE_NAME_RNG should be re-seeded for each page being compiled, seed based on hash of the page route (plugins/compiler.py:821)

all supported OS provide a mechanism for watching a filesystem for changes without polling. we cannot be walking the filesystem and stat'ing files every 0.05 seconds... we should be subscribing to changes in the file tree (compile_daemon.py:519)

P1 Preloaded App Untracked: when config.app_module has already been loaded before get_app() runs, this branch returns the cached module inside the recorder instead of replaying the app import (prerequisites.py:208, 2026-08-09, re-raised on current head)
